title: Be bold and let loose!
text: You will have so much fun once you let yourself let loose and have a good time. It is so much fun to dance and learn since I’ve never done something like this before!
author: Ashli_V

title: Top of Montjuic where the views were stunning. Private lesson and overall just so much fun!!!
text: Pabla was amazing. Her teaching technique made it easy to pick up. The location was perfect and and an hour and a half we were successfully dancing salsa!
author: DayTrip60807053099

title: The most fun we had in Barcelona
text: We had a lot of fun dancing salsa. A great activity even for beginners! We learned a lot that day!!!
author: Sandra_U
